notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the tnlandforms statewide list and the Forest Lookouts index name this tower, so the story is short on purpose. Two web searches, the cached NHLR Georgia index (this tower not listed) and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia chapter PDFs (2012, 2013, 2023) found nothing on its build, staffing or fate; the Wikipedia article on Alapaha does not mention a tower. The about 1 km offset from the town's Wikipedia point is our calculation from the coordinates, not a source's. A human may want to hold this story until a Georgia Forestry Commission record or a local source turns up.
